## Function to visualize shape change
```{r}
# This function ingests PCA object and then creates a figure depicting shape change vectors along given PCA axis plotted on maximum shape for a given axis

plot_morpho_change <- function(PCA.object, axis_number, Procrustes.object, wireframe) {
  # Retrive PC axis data
  PC_axis <- PCA.object$x[,axis_number]
  # Retrive Procrustes coordinates
  coords <- Procrustes.object$coords
  # Predict shape change along the selected PC axis
  preds <- shape.predictor(coords, x = PC_axis, Intercept = FALSE, 
                            pred.min = min(PC_axis),  
                            pred.max = max(PC_axis))
  
  # Convert predictions to data frames
  landmarks_min <- as.data.frame(preds$pred.min)
  landmarks_max <- as.data.frame(preds$pred.max)
  
  # Add landmark indices and PC labels
  landmarks_min$ID <- 1:nrow(landmarks_min)
  landmarks_min$PC <- "min"
  landmarks_max$ID <- 1:nrow(landmarks_max)
  landmarks_max$PC <- "max"
  
  # Merge min and max shapes into a single dataframe
  landmarks_df <- rbind(landmarks_min, landmarks_max)

  # Convert wireframe to dataframe
  wireframe_df <- data.frame(wireframe)
  colnames(wireframe_df) <- c("V1", "V2")
  
  # Merge wireframe with landmark coordinates
  wireframe_plot <- wireframe_df %>%
    left_join(landmarks_max, by = c("V1" = "ID")) %>%
    rename(Y1 = Y, X1 = X) %>%
    left_join(landmarks_max, by = c("V2" = "ID")) %>%
    rename(Y2 = Y, X2 = X)
  
  # Create ggplot with shape change vectors and wireframe
  change_plot <- ggplot(filter(landmarks_df, PC == "min"), aes(x = Y, y = X)) +
    # Wireframe connections
    geom_segment(data = wireframe_plot, 
                 aes(x = Y1, y = X1, xend = Y2, yend = X2), 
                 color = "lightgray", linewidth = 0.5) +
    
    # Morphological change vectors
    geom_segment(data = landmarks_df %>% 
                   pivot_wider(names_from = PC, 
                               values_from = c(Y, X)), 
                 aes(x = Y_min, y = X_min, xend = Y_max, yend = X_max),
                 linewidth = 0.4,
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm"), type = "closed"),
                 color = "black") +
    
    # Plot landmarks (starting shape)
    geom_point(shape = 21, fill = "darkgrey", size = 1.8) +
    
    # Aesthetic adjustments
    coord_fixed() +
    theme(axis.line = element_blank(),
          axis.title = element_blank(), 
          axis.text = element_blank(), 
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), 
          panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), 
          panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank())
  
  filename <- paste0(deparse(substitute(PCA.object)), "_PC", axis_number, ".pdf")
  ggsave(filename = filename, plot = change_plot, device = "pdf",
         width = 5, height = 5, units = "cm")
  
  return(change_plot)
  
}

```

# Analysis
## Retrive nectophore dimensions
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# to assure proper XY alignment, knowing that Y extent is always larger in nectophores
tps_data2 <- tps_data
apply(tps_data2, 3, function(spec) range(spec[,1]) > range(spec[,2]))

for (i in 1:dim(tps_data2)[3]) {
  if (diff(range(tps_data2[,1,i])) < diff(range(tps_data2[,2,i]))) {
    tps_data2[,,i] <- tps_data[,c(2,1),i]  # Swap X and Y back
  }
}
# Nectophore height (distance from mouth plate indentation (1) to the thrust block tip (9))
nectophore_height <- abs(tps_data2[1,1,] - tps_data2[9,1,])

# Nectophore height (distance from lm7 urc insertion to rc, to lm19 urc bent to lower surface)
nectosac_height <- abs(tps_data2[19,1,] - tps_data2[7,1,])
```

## general procrustes
```{r}
# Generalized Procrustes analysis
gpa <- gpagen(tps_data)

# Invert XY and take negative of Y to align nectophore longer axis along Y
gpa$coords <- gpa$coords[, c(2, 1), ]
gpa$coords[,2,] <- gpa$coords[,2,] * -1
```

## Geomorph dataframe
```{r}
# convert to geomorph_dataframe
species_lookup <- setNames(meta_data$Species, meta_data$Image_ID)
image_ids <- dimnames(gpa$coords)[[3]]
species_info <- species_lookup[image_ids]

gpa.gdf <- geomorph.data.frame(shape=gpa$coords, 
                               species = species_info, 
                               ind = image_ids,
                               Csize = gpa$Csize,
                               nectophore_height = nectophore_height,
                               nectosac_height = nectosac_height,
                               necto_rate = nectophore_height/nectosac_height)

# quick check of point assignment
plotAllSpecimens(gpa$coords, links = necto_wire)

# identify outliers - this indicated small nectophores to be outliers across species, but these were retained
plotOutliers(gpa$coords, inspect.outliers = T)
```

## Symmetry analysis
```{r}
landmark.pairs <- matrix(c(2, 16, 
                            3, 15, 
                            4, 14, 
                            5, 13, 
                            6, 12, 
                            10, 11, 
                            18, 20), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)
nectophore.sym <- bilat.symmetry(A = shape, 
                                 ind = ind, 
                                 object.sym = TRUE, 
                                 land.pairs = landmark.pairs,
                                 data = gpa.gdf,
                                 RRPP = TRUE)

# Extract ANOVA table 
anova_df <- as.data.frame(nectophore.sym$shape.anova)
anova_df <- cbind(Term = rownames(anova_df), anova_df)
# Save to CSV file
write.csv(anova_df, "results/nectophore_shape_anova.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# visualize symmetric and asymmetric components
plotAllSpecimens(nectophore.sym$symm.shape)
plotAllSpecimens(nectophore.sym$asymm.shape)

# Extract mean symmetric and asymmetric shapes
mean_symm <- mshape(nectophore.sym$symm.shape)
mean_asymm <- mshape(nectophore.sym$asymm.shape)

# Plot the symmetric (reference) vs asymmetric (target) shape
plotRefToTarget(mean_symm, mean_asymm,
                method = "vector",   # or "TPS" for deformation grids
                mag = 3,             # magnification factor for visibility
                gridPars = gridPar(pt.bg = "lightgray", pt.size = 1),
                rgl = FALSE)
```

## PCA
```{r}
# PCA on all data
barg.PCA <- gm.prcomp(gpa$coords)
pca.geo <- prcomp(two.d.array(gpa$coords)) # for axes loading
barg.PCA
# generate mean shape
mean.barg <- mshape(gpa$coords)
mean.shape <- gpa$consensus 

# extract PCA scores and merge with metadata
pca_scores <- as.data.frame(barg.PCA$x)  # Convert PCA scores to a data frame
pca_scores <- rownames_to_column(pca_scores)
colnames(pca_scores)[1] <- "Image_ID"
pca_data <- merge(pca_scores, meta_data, by=c("Image_ID"))

# append length of nectophore
pca_data$nectophore_height <- nectophore_height
pca_data$nectophore_height <- nectophore_height

# Screeplot
summarydf <- summary(barg.PCA)
summarydf <- data.frame(matrix(unlist(summarydf), ncol=3, byrow=TRUE))
summarydf$PC <- paste0("PC", 1:36)
colnames(summarydf) <- c("eigenvalues", "proportion of variance", "cummulative proportions", "PC")

summarydf$PC <- factor(summarydf$PC, levels = summarydf$PC)
screeplot <- ggplot(summarydf[1:10,], aes(x=PC, y=`proportion of variance`))+
  geom_bar(stat="identity", fill = "darkgrey")+
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "black") +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1), color = "black", linetype = "dashed")+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1))+
  ylab("Proportion of explained variance") +
  xlab("PC axis")+
  th

ggsave(filename = "results/Fig_screeplot.tiff", plot = screeplot, device = "tiff",
       width = 9, height = 9, units = "cm")
```

### Axes loading
```{r}
axes_list <- 1:4
contrib_list <- list()

for (axis in axes_list) {
  pca.contrib <- fviz_contrib(pca.geo, choice = "var", axes = axis)
  LM_contrib <- data.frame(LM = as.character(1:(nrow(pca.contrib$data)/2)), 
                           contrib = sapply(1:(nrow(pca.contrib$data)/2), 
                                            function(i) sum(pca.contrib$data[(i*2-1):(i*2),]$contrib)))
  colnames(LM_contrib)[2] <- paste0("pca.contrib", axis)
  contrib_list[[axis]] <- LM_contrib
}

pca.loading <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "LM"), contrib_list)

write.csv(pca.loading, "results/pca_loading.csv")

```

## Phylomorphospace
### Read and update tree
```{r}
# reroot multigene phylogeny
plot(barg.tree, no.margin=TRUE,edge.width=2,cex=0.7) 
barg.tree.reroot <- reroot(barg.tree, node = which(barg.tree$tip.label == "YPM-IZ-111816"))

# retain single tip per Bargmannia species
retain.tip <- c("D725-D8", "SRR23143264", "D961-D3", "D666-D10", "D611-D6", "D669-SS5","Bargmannia_elongata_T1109D2")
barg.trunc.tree <- keep.tip(barg.tree.reroot, retain.tip)
plot(barg.trunc.tree)

# relabel tips 
barg.trunc.tree$tip.label[barg.trunc.tree$tip.label=="D725-D8"] <- "B. marlena"
barg.trunc.tree$tip.label[barg.trunc.tree$tip.label=="SRR23143264"] <- "B. lata"
barg.trunc.tree$tip.label[barg.trunc.tree$tip.label=="D961-D3"] <- "B. profunda"
barg.trunc.tree$tip.label[barg.trunc.tree$tip.label=="D666-D10"] <- "B. stenotes"
barg.trunc.tree$tip.label[barg.trunc.tree$tip.label=="D611-D6"] <- "B. pyrosa"
barg.trunc.tree$tip.label[barg.trunc.tree$tip.label=="D669-SS5"] <- "B. amoena"
barg.trunc.tree$tip.label[barg.trunc.tree$tip.label=="Bargmannia_elongata_T1109D2"] <- "B. elongata"
```

### Plot - phylo
```{r}
# PCA with phylogenetic element 
pca.w.phylo2 <- gm.prcomp(mshape.by.species, phy = barg.trunc.tree, align.to.phy = TRUE)
phylo.plot <- plot(pca.w.phylo2, phylo = TRUE)
phylo.sum <- summary(pca.w.phylo2)

# retrive necessary data for ggplotting
phylo_proj <- as.data.frame(phylo.plot[["phylo"]][["phy.pcdata"]])
phylo_proj$species <- rownames(phylo_proj)
phylo_proj$species <- gsub("\\.+", ". ", phylo_proj$species)
phylo_proj$Type <- ifelse(1:13 <= 7, "Species", "Node")
phylo_proj$edgeID <- c(1:13)

# data for edge connections
connections_df <- as.data.frame(phylo.plot[["phylo"]][["phy"]][["edge"]])
connections <- merge(connections_df, phylo_proj, by.x = "V1", by.y = "edgeID")
connections <- merge(connections, phylo_proj, by.x = "V2", by.y = "edgeID", suffixes = c("_V1", "_V2"))

# generate plots 
phylo.PCA <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = connections, 
               aes(x = Comp1_V1, y = Comp2_V1, xend = Comp1_V2, yend = Comp2_V2), 
               color = "black",
               linewidth=0.2) +
  geom_point(data = subset(phylo_proj, Type == "Node"), 
             aes(x = Comp1, y = Comp2), 
             color = "black", 
             fill = "white",
             shape = 21,
             size = 0.8)+
  geom_point(data = subset(phylo_proj, Type == "Species"),
             aes(x = Comp1, y = Comp2, color = species), size = 2) +
  geom_text_repel(data = subset(phylo_proj, Type == "Species"),
                  aes(x = Comp1, y = Comp2,
                      label = species), size = 2,
                  fontface = "italic",
                  nudge_x = -.02,
                  min.segment.length = Inf) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sp.palette.abb)+
  th + 
  xlab(paste0("PC1 (", round(phylo.sum[["PC.summary"]][["Comp1"]][[2]] * 100, 2), "%)"))+
  ylab(paste0("PC2 (", round(phylo.sum[["PC.summary"]][["Comp2"]][[2]] * 100, 2), "%)"))+
  xlim(-0.11, 0.2)+
  theme( axis.text.x = element_text(size=7, colour ="black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=7, colour ="black"),
        axis.title=element_text(size=8, face="bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 7))
```


## Allometry
```{r}
size.model <- procD.lm(shape~species, data = gpa.gdf, iter = 999)
summary(size.model)

size.model1 <- procD.lm(shape~nectophore_height+species, data = gpa.gdf, iter = 999)
summary(size.model1)

size.model2 <- procD.lm(shape~nectophore_height*species, data = gpa.gdf, iter = 999)
summary(size.model2)

anova(size.model, size.model1, size.model2)

allometry.sp.pw <- pairwise(fit = size.model2, 
                         fit.null = size.model,
                         groups = gpa.gdf$species)

# generate heatmap of p across model 
heat_data <- (summary(allometry.sp.pw))
heat_data2 <- as.data.frame(heat_data["summary.table"])
heat_data2$species<- rownames(heat_data2)

heat_data2[c('Species1', 'Species2')] <- str_split_fixed(heat_data2$species, ':', 2)

heatmap.allom <- ggplot(heat_data2, aes(x = Species1, y = Species2, fill = `summary.table.Pr...d`)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey", high = NA, na.value = NA) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f",`summary.table.Pr...d`)), color = "black", size = 3)+
  th
heatmap.allom


x<-plotAllometry(fit=size.model2, size = (gpa.gdf$nectophore_height),
              col = as.factor(gpa.gdf$species), method="PredLine")


allom.data <- as.data.frame(x[["plot_args"]][["col"]])
allom.data$Reg.Score <- x[["RegScore"]]
allom.data$PredLine <- x[["PredLine"]]
allom.data$Csize <- gpa.gdf$Csize
allom.data$nectophore_height <- nectophore_height
allom.data$specimen <- meta_data$Specimen
allom.data$photo <- meta_data$Image_ID
colnames(allom.data) <- c("species", "reg.score", "predline", "csize", 
                          "nectophore_height", "specimen", "photo")
tail(allom.data$nectophore_height)
tail(gpa.gdf$nectophore_height)
allometry.plot <- ggplot(allom.data, 
                         aes(x=log(nectophore_height), y=predline, color = species))+
  geom_point(shape=16, size = 2, alpha=0.75) +
  th+
  scale_color_manual(values=sp.palette.abb)+
  xlab("log(Nectophore height [mm])")+
  ylab("Predicted shape")+
  theme( axis.text.x = element_text(size=7, colour ="black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=7, colour ="black"),
        axis.title=element_text(size=8, face="bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 7))

allom.test <- procD.lm(shape ~ log(nectophore_height) * species, data = gpa.gdf)

allom.summary <- summary(allom.test)
allom.test.table <- as.data.frame(allom.summary$table)
write.csv(allom.test.table, "results/allom.test.csv")
```

## Nectophore:nectosac
```{r}
bar_data <- as.data.frame(species_info)
bar_data$nectophore <- nectophore_height
bar_data$nectosac <- nectosac_height                               
bar_data <- bar_data %>%
  mutate(necto_rate = nectophore/nectosac)


nectophore.dim <- ggplot(bar_data, aes(x=species_info, y=necto_rate, color=species_info, fill=species_info))+
  stat_boxplot(geom ='errorbar', width = 0.4, color = "black")+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.color = NA, color="black", outlier.size = NA, alpha = .2)+
  geom_jitter(size = 2, aes(color = species_info, alpha = .7), width = 0.3)+
  scale_color_manual(values=sp.palette.abb)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=sp.palette.abb)+
  th+
  theme( axis.text.x = element_text(size=7, colour ="black", face = "italic"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=7, colour ="black"),
        axis.title=element_text(size=8, face="bold"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 7))+
  ylab("nectophore : nectosac")+
  xlab("Species")

# run Shapiro-Wilk test for normality
shapiro_results_nec_nec <- bar_data %>%
  group_by(species_info) %>%
  summarise(p_value = shapiro.test(necto_rate)$p.value)
write.csv(shapiro_results_nec_nec, "results/shapiro_results_nec_nec.csv")

# run Kruskal-Wallis test with Dunn post-hoc between cell types
stat.test_nec_bec <- bar_data %>%
  kruskal_test(necto_rate ~ species_info)

write.csv(stat.test_nec_bec, "results/KWtest_nect_necto.csv")

dunn.test_nec_nec <- bar_data %>%
  dunn_test(necto_rate ~ species_info, p.adjust.method = "holm") %>%
  select(group1, group2, statistic, p.adj) %>%
  mutate(
    statistic = round(statistic, 3),
    p.adj = round(p.adj, 3)
  ) %>%
  filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>%
  rename('Species 1' = group1,
         'Species 2' = group2,
         'Z statistic' = statistic,
         'Adjusted p-value' = p.adj)
write.csv(dunn.test_nec_nec, "results/dunn_test_nect_necto.csv")



```
